confirm.title: Confirm your request
confirm.lead: You wrote to the First Move assistant, which answers with AI. Confirm once, and it reads your message.
confirm.accept: I accept the Terms and emails about my request. No marketing.
confirm.missing: This page needs the link from the confirmation email.

result.confirmed: Thank you. Your request is confirmed; the assistant answers by email.
result.expired: This link has expired. Write to the assistant again to get a new one.
result.used: This link was already used. If you confirmed before, the assistant has your request.
result.invalid: This link is not valid. Please use the link from the email.
result.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.

layout.tagline: Screening for fifth-generation district heating and cooling
layout.ai: Written by an AI system. It can be wrong and is not binding.
layout.human: Privacy or legal requests, or anything for a person: {address}
layout.commands: Reply “new” to start over, or “stop” to end the conversation and delete it.

confirm.title: Please confirm your request
body: The First Move assistant received your message. It answers with AI, so it needs your confirmation once before it reads anything.
By confirming you accept the Terms ({terms}) and emails about your request. No marketing.
Your message waits up to {days} days for your confirmation. If you did not write to us, ignore this email: nothing is processed.
confirm.linkHint: If the button does not work, open this link:

warning.title: Only First Move topics, please
body: The First Move assistant only helps with First Move: the Quick Check, the Business Plan and fifth-generation district heating and cooling. Your message was not answered.
Please keep to these topics. After one more such message, this address is paused for {days} days.

ban.title: This address is paused
body: This address is paused for {days} days after repeated messages outside the assistant's topics. Until then, messages from it are not answered.

block.title: Your request is blocked
body: Your request is blocked for now while an admin reviews it.

unavailable.title: The assistant cannot answer right now
body: The First Move assistant cannot answer right now. Please try again later.

menu.title: What would you like to do?
menu.lead: By email I can run First Move's Quick Check with you, work through a Business Plan, or both. The results come from First Move's own calculation, the same as in the dashboard.

quickCheck.label: Quick Check
quickCheck.description: A first technical and economic screening of your site.

businessPlan.label: Business Plan
businessPlan.description: Your business model in four steps, in your own words.

both.label: Both
both.description: The Quick Check first, then the Business Plan.

menu.file: Would you also like a project file (.firstmove.json) to continue in the dashboard? Yes or no.
menu.howTo: Reply with the number and yes or no, for example: 1, yes

answer.title: Your question
answer.fallback: I can't answer that by email. The docs explain how First Move works: {link}

questions.lead: Answer in one email, numbered like the questions. The examples show the format.
questions.leadBusinessPlan: Answer in your own words, numbered like the questions. Skip what you don't know yet. Reply “next” to go on to the next step.
questions.attachments: Instead of typing, you can attach documents: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or text, or a First Move project file (.firstmove.json).
questions.file: And: would you like the project file (.firstmove.json) with the results? Yes or no.

buildings.question: How many buildings are in the project area?

area.question: How large is the project area, in m²? Hectares are fine too.

mix.question: What is the building mix? Give the share of each building type and construction period in %. All shares add up to 100 %.
mix.example: Residential buildings 1961-1990: 60 %, Residential buildings 2011-today: 30 %, Category A 1991-2010: 10 %

sources.question: Which energy sources are available, and how high is their potential: low, medium, high or unknown?
sources.example: Ground water: high, ambient air: medium

pv.question: Is photovoltaic (PV) available for the heat pumps? Yes or no.

demand.question: Do you know the total annual heating and cooling demand, in kWh/a?

network.question: Do you know the length of the network, in m?

bp.next: Thank you. On to the next step.
bp.nothing: I found no answers for this step in your email. Reply with numbered answers, or “next” to skip the step.

progress.title: What I understood
progress.nothing: I found no values for your project in this email.
progress.sum: The shares add up to {sum} %; they must add up to 100 %.

reasons.not-in-scope: not a value I can use here
reasons.missing-item: which entry it belongs to is unclear
reasons.ambiguous-number: the number can be read two ways; write it without thousands separators
reasons.unit-mismatch: the unit does not fit this field

reasons.unsupported: this file type can't be read; please send PDF, Word, Excel, CSV or text
reasons.macro: files with macros are not opened
reasons.binary-office: old Office formats can't be read; please save it as .docx or .xlsx
reasons.zip-bomb: the file is too large when unpacked
reasons.unsafe: the file contains text that looks like instructions to the assistant, so it was not used
reasons.unchecked: the file could not be checked right now; please send it again later
reasons.unavailable: the file could not be downloaded
reasons.no-text: no text found, for example a scanned PDF
reasons.project: the project file could not be opened: {detail}

results.title: Your Quick Check result
results.lead: Computed by First Move's own Quick Check engine from the values below, the same calculation as in the dashboard.
results.notesLead: Each step in one sentence, with the equations of the methodology it uses. All equations: {link}
results.estimatedLength: The network length is estimated from the building density and the project area.

businessPlan.title: Your Business Plan
businessPlan.lead: Your answers as the dashboard would show them. The Business Plan is qualitative: it calculates nothing of its own.
businessPlan.readinessLead: How much of the final pitch already has content. It counts filled fields only and does not judge what you wrote.

file.attached: Your project file is attached: {name}. Import it in the dashboard to continue there: {link}
file.offer: Reply “file” to get a project file (.firstmove.json) for the dashboard.
file.provenance: Values I took from your emails are marked as AI-proposed in the file, so the dashboard shows them as such.

reminder.menu: When you're ready, choose 1, 2 or 3 above.
reminder.collect: We are still collecting your project data; the questions are in my last email.
reminder.results: Your results are in my last email. Send changed values at any time, and I recompute.

handoff.title: A person takes over
handoff.body: I passed your message on to a person at First Move, who will answer you by email. For privacy and legal requests, you can also write to {address} directly.
handoff.again: A person at First Move already has your earlier message and will answer you by email. You can also write to {address} directly.

stopped.title: Conversation ended
stopped.body: I ended our conversation and deleted the project data I collected. If you want your confirmation record or anything else deleted too, write to {address}.
stopped.nothing: There was no conversation to end.

conversation.restarted: We start over. Your earlier answers are deleted.

limit.title: This conversation is long enough for email
limit.body: Please continue in the dashboard, where you can change every value directly: {link}. Reply “file” to get your project file, or “new” to start over.

admin.subject: First Move assistant: {kind}

details.rate-global: The daily limit of {limit} emails for all senders is reached. Further email today gets no answer.
details.budget: Today's model budget of {budget} USD is spent. The assistant answers no email until the next day (UTC).
details.text-failed: The language model did not answer. The sender was asked to try again later; further failures today send no alert.

admin.more: More alerts today were not sent (at most {max} a day).

kinds.rate-global: daily limit for all mail reached
kinds.handoff: a sender asked for a person

handoff.subject: Hand-off from the assistant: {subject}

relay.subject: Mail to {inbox}: {subject}
relay.replyable: Reply to this email to answer the sender.
relay.unverified: The sender's address could not be verified (DMARC did not pass), so replying does not reach them. Check the original before you answer.
relay.more: More emails to {inbox} today were not passed on (at most {max} a day). Open the human@ inbox in Resend.
